$Comment: The skeleton every Harvest Feast contract inherits through Parent. It is never posted.
Season hides every contract built on it while the feast is off; a child that writes its own
Requires keeps it, since Season is a leaf of its own. Listing files each one with the contracts.
Rewards.Claim is what every job on the feast board pays, like every contract's: the pay waits at the
board until the player collects it. The board leaves with the feast, and a job finished but not
collected by then shows Collect in the player's Objective Book instead, so its pay never waits a
year for the board to come back. The list is the board's pay table, a little favor
with Martha and a little Festival Favor. A child that writes its own Rewards.Claim replaces the list
whole. Each bucket inherits on its own, so a list left in Rewards.Auto here would pay on top of every
child's Claim. A child names its board and band in Boards and its work in Objectives, and takes its
words from the keys its id spells (quest.<id>.title and .flavor).
